design_philosophy.direction: Klassisch & seriös (Classic & serious). A trustworthy, established German corporate B2B aesthetic.
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Black cards or dark mode elements (except footer)
Excessive animations, floating elements, or parallax

brand.name: Tdata
brand.legal_entity: MO Handel & Service, Inh. Mariusz Otok
brand.logo_concept: A classic, minimalist text-based logo. A serif 'T' in primary green next to a clean sans-serif 'data' in dark charcoal. Provide this as a purely SVG/CSS construct in the Header component. Avoid the old 'W' Webora logo.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl font-serif text-[#223322] leading-tight tracking-normal
hierarchy.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-serif text-[#223322] leading-snug mb-6

spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Traditional structural columns. 12-column foundation. Use 1, 2, or 3 column grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with gap-8 or gap-12. NO bento layouts. Maintain symmetric or calm asymmetric balance.

components.buttons: Rectangular (rounded-sm or rounded-none). Solid primary color background with white text. Minimal hover effect (darken color). Padding px-6 py-3. NO glow, NO shadows.
components.cards: White background (#FFFFFF). Sharp corners or very subtle rounding (rounded-sm). 1px solid border (#DDE8DD). Flat design. On hover, maybe a very slight structural shadow (shadow-sm) or 1px border color change to primary. Content inside must have generous padding (p-8).
components.navbar: Solid white background (#FFFFFF). 1px bottom border (#DDE8DD). Sticky top, but NO glassmorphism (backdrop-blur is forbidden). Clear, simple links.
components.footer: Dark green background (#1A261A). Strict columnar layout. Must include 'Tdata Testing' and 'MO Handel & Service, Inh. Mariusz Otok' in the copyright/legal section.
components.forms: Standard rectangular inputs. border-[#DDE8DD], focus:border-[#659A65] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#659A65]. left-aligned labels.

motion.strategy: Minimal and constrained. Fade-ins on scroll only. Fast UI transitions (150ms). No bouncy or playful physics. 'Seriös' means stable.

images_and_assets.strategy: Professional, realistic corporate photography. Bright lighting, realistic testing environments, clean offices.

hero.description: Corporate office building architecture for home hero

careers.description: Professional team collaborating, great for 'Karriere' page

pages_to_build: Home: Hero (trust-focused text, calm background), Dienstleistungen overview, Warum Wir (checkmarks), Stats (standard size), CTA.
Unternehmen: About text, mission, team/office image.
Dienstleistungen: Detailed service list (QA, Automation, App Testing).
Karriere: Job openings list, simple standard application form.
Kontakt: Contact info, map placeholder, serious B2B contact form.
Impressum: Legal imprint (text heavy, standard layout).
Datenschutz: Privacy policy (text heavy, standard layout).
instructions_to_main_agent: Remove all references to Webora, replace with Tdata or Tdata Testing.
Implement the Merriweather font for headings and Source Sans 3 for body text. Do NOT use Inter, Sora, or Roboto for headings.
Strictly follow the color palette. Backgrounds should be white or #F4F8F4. No dark mode apart from the footer.
Avoid Shadcn 'Cards' if they default to heavy rounded borders and shadows. Use standard HTML/Tailwind with border, p-8, rounded-sm.
Create the specific requested pages with fully functional React Router navigation.
Do not add floating 3D elements, marquee scrollbars, or bento grids. Keep it classic and serious.
Ensure Impressum and Datenschutz contain realistic placeholders indicating Tdata Testing, MO Handel & Service, Inh. Mariusz Otok, and emails ending in @tdata-testing.de.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
In this specific project, do NOT use glass-morphism or heavy shadows. Stick to the classic aesthetic.
Do not center-align long paragraphs of text. Left-align for better readability.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements.
